noop.description: Does nothing. Useful for resetting persistent variants.

m_syntax_shim.description: Shim to handle erroring for removed syntax.

beta.description: Makes custom words appear as beta text.

anchor.description: Sets the anchor of a sign text. https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/handbook/text-anchors.html

font.description: Applies a font to a sign text object.

align.description: Applies a font to a sign text object.

direction.description: Sets the direction of a tile.

frame.description: Sets the animation frame of a sprite.

tiling.description: Alters the tiling of a tile. Only works on tiles that tile.

animation_frame.description: Sets the animation frame of a tile.

sleep.description: Makes the tile fall asleep. Only functions correctly on character tiles.

textwidth.description: Sets the width of the custom text the text generator tries to expand to.

default_color_index.description: Sets the default color of a tile by index.

default_color_palette.description: Sets the default color of a tile by name.

inactive.description: Applies the color that an inactive text of a tile's color would have. This only operates on the default color!

custom.description: Forces custom generation of the text.

letter.description: Makes custom words appear as letter groups.

oneline.description: Makes custom words appear in one line.

frames.description: Sets the wobble of the tile to the specified frame(s). 1 or 3 can be specified.

apply.description: Immediately applies a sprite's default color.
apply.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

color.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

posterize.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

gradient.description:
Applies a gradient to a tile.
Interpolates color through CIELUV color space by default. This can be toggled with the `raw` argument.
If `extrapolate` is enabled, then colors outside the gradient will be extrapolated, as opposed to clamping from 0% to 100%.
Enabling `dither` does nothing with `steps` set to 0.
gradient.syntax: <gradient|grad><color: Color>/[angle: float = 0.0]/[width: float = 1.0]/[offset: float = 0]/[steps: int = 0]/[raw: bool = False]/[extrapolate: bool = False]/[dither: bool = False]
gradient.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

overlay.description: Applies an overlay to a sprite. X and Y can be given to offset the overlay.
overlay.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

property.description: Applies a property plate to a sprite.
property.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

hide.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

rotate.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

rotate3d.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

scale.description: Scales a sprite by the given multipliers.
scale.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

nineslice.description: Stretches the sprite to the given width and height multiplier using the 9-Slices algorithm.
nineslice.syntax: <9s|nineslice><w: int>/[h: int = 0]/[left: int = 4]/[top: int = 4]/[right: int = None]/[bottom: int = None]/[kind: Literal["stretch", "repeat"] = "repeat"]
nineslice.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

pad.description: Pads the sprite by the specified values.
pad.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

pixelate.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

meta.description: Applies a meta filter to an sprite.
meta.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

outline.description: Applies an outline to a sprite.
outline.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

omni.description: Gives the tile an overlay, like the omni text.
omni.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

land.description: Removes all space between the sprite and its bounding box on the specified side.
land.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

bbox.description: Puts the sprite's bounding box behind it. Useful for debugging.
bbox.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

warp.description:
Warps the sprite by displacing the bounding box's corners.
    Point 1 is top-left, point 2 is top-right, point 3 is bottom-right, and point 4 is bottom-left.
    If the sprite grows past its original bounding box, it will need to be recentered manually.
warp.syntax: <warp><x1: int>/<y1: int>/<x2: int>/<y2: int>/<x3: int>/<y3: int>/<x4: int>/<y4: int>
warp.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

matmul.description: Multiplies the sprite by the given RGBA matrix.
matmul.syntax: <matrix|mm|matmul><aa: float>/<ab: float>/<ac: float>/<ad: float>/<ba: float>/<bb: float>/<bc: float>/<bd: float>/<ca: float>/<cb: float>/<cc: float>/<cd: float>/<da: float>/<db: float>/<dc: float>/<dd: float>/[ea: float = None]/[eb: float = None]/[ec: float = None]/[ed: float = None]
matmul.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

clip.description: Crops the sprite to within its grid space.
clip.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

neon.description: Darkens the inside of each region of color.
neon.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

scan.description: Removes rows or columns of pixels to create a scan line effect.
scan.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

flip.description: Flips the sprite along the specified axis.
flip.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

mirror.description: Mirrors the sprite along the specified direction.
mirror.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

normalize.description: Centers the sprite on its visual bounding box.
normalize.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

floodfill.description: Floodfills either inside or outside a sprite with a given brightness value.
floodfill.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

pointfill.description: Floodfills a sprite starting at a given point.
pointfill.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

remove.description: Removes a certain color from the sprite. If `invert` is on, then it removes all but that color.
remove.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

replace.description: Replaces a certain color with a different color. If `invert` is on, then it replaces all but that color.
replace.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

color_select.description: Keeps only the selected colors, indexed by their occurrence. This changes per-frame, not per-tile.
color_select.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

color_slice.description: Keeps only the slice of colors, indexed by their occurrence. This changes per-frame, not per-tile.
color_slice.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

color_shift.description: Shifts the colors of a sprite around, by index of occurence.
color_shift.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

croppoly.description: Crops the sprite to the specified polygon.
croppoly.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

snippoly.description: Snips the sprite to the specified polygon.
snippoly.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

aberrate.description: Abberates the colors of a sprite.
aberrate.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

opacity.description: Sets the opacity of the sprite, from 0 to 1.
opacity.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

negative.description: Inverts the sprite's RGB or RGBA values.
negative.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

wrap.description: Wraps the sprite around its image box.
wrap.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

melt.description: Removes transparent pixels from each row/column and shifts the remaining ones to the end.
melt.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

bend.description: Displaces the sprite by a wave. Frequency is a percentage of the sprite's size along the axis.
bend.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

hueshift.description: Shifts the hue of the sprite. 0 to 360.
hueshift.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

brightness.description: Sets the brightness of the sprite.
brightness.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

palette_snap.description: Snaps all the colors in the tile to the specified palette.
palette_snap.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

wave.description: Displaces the sprite per-slice by a wave. Frequency is a percentage of the sprite's size along the axis.
wave.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

saturation.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

blank.description: Sets a sprite to pure white.
blank.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

liquify.description: "Liquifies" the tile by melting every color except the main color and distributing the main color downwards.
liquify.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

planet.description: Turns the tile into a planet by melting every color except the main color and distributing the main color in a circle.
planet.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

normalize_lightness.description: Normalizes a sprite's HSL lightness, bringing the lightest value up to full brightness.
normalize_lightness.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

crop.description:
Crops the sprite to the specified bounding box.
    If the `change_bbox` toggle is on, then the sprite's bounding box is altered, as opposed to removing pixels.
crop.syntax: <crop|cr><x: int>/<y: int>/<u: int>/<v: int>/[change_bbox: bool = False]
crop.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

snip.description: Snips the specified box out of the sprite.
snip.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

convert.description: Converts the sprite's color space to or from RGB. Mostly for use with :matrix.
convert.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

threshold.description:
Removes all pixels below a threshold.
This can be used in conjunction with blur, opacity, and additive blending to create a bloom effect!
If a value is negative, it removes pixels above the threshold instead.
threshold.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

blur.description: Blurs a sprite. Uses box blur by default, though gaussian blur can be used with the boolean toggle.
blur.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

fisheye.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

filterimage.description: Applies a filter image to a sprite. For information about filter images, look at the filterimage command.
filterimage.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

glitch.description: Randomly displaces a sprite's pixels. An RNG seed is created using the tile's attributes if not specified.
glitch.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

convolve.description: Convolves the sprite with the given 2D convolution matrix. Information on these can be found at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kernel_(image_processing)
convolve.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

splice.description: Splices a portion of the sprite onto itself.
splice.syntax: <splice|sp><source_x: int>/<source_y: int>/<width: int>/<height: int>/<dest_x: int>/<dest_y: int>/[mode: Literal["replace", "composite", "add", "multiply"] = "replace"]/[color: Color = None]
splice.applied: While applying effects to sprite image

blending.description: Sets the blending mode for a tile.

displace.description: Displaces the tile by the specified coordinates.
